text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"—I saw Special Week's final workout the other day, and she's in top gear!
Looks like we're in for one heck of a race...!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky seems to be in great shape too.
I can't wait to see how Stay Gold and the others face her~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Auu~, it's so frustrating...! 
If only I had been able to run today too~~...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Let's watch over them together.
Spe-chan's race, and Stego-senpai's—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...The me of that other world
ran for a long time, spanning across eras."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
And so,
perhaps it's because I've seen so many meetings and partings.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: The time spent with those girls, sharing that unique bond of being in the same generation... felt surprisingly comforting.
choice_data_list: ...That just shows how much they meant to you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. This journey made me realize it all over again.
...I don't know about the me in another world, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "At the very least, I quite like this 'generation' of ours."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Those guys... are amusing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'll go show them.
The time I spent running with those girls.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Right, let's give it all we've got.
Lady Stego~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ooh, Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Unfortunately, both Fukukitaru-sama and Suzuka-sama
have decided to sit out this race, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Having Lady Stego around
feels strangely reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it strange?
Even though we're rivals competing against each other."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not weird at all.
――I feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Having you run alongside me today is really reassuring.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I am truly honored to hear you say that.
After all—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I will continue on unchanged as "Stay Gold's classmate,"
running in races for a loooong time to come~.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...I would be truly honored.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...All right! Then how about we show Spe and the others how it's done?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Showing the pride of our generation, that is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Both Stego-san and Bright-san have such incredible intensity......!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I consider myself the representative of our generation, after all.
...Naturally, I'm all fired up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I shall show you~.
The bond of spring rolls, honed through friendly rivalry~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
W-Why does it
sound so delicious?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, Spe-chan, you mustn't go along with their pace.
Both of them are quite tricky customers, after all~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My. I've received a compliment~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's just how she is~.
Well, I'll just take it nice and easy myself.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "Considering that, Sky seems pretty fired up herself, doesn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...I'll leave that to your imaginatio~n.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally pumped up and ready!
After all, I made a promise
with Stego-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: "Going for the win representing our whole generation...?!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for keeping your promise.
Thanks to that, on my end too—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Now I'm all fired up again.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us enjoy it.
Our Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!
